#QueenOfUrbanProphecy is a romantic drama set on a music tour.

But it's really about a young woman who becomes politicized when:

1. her rap unwittingly predicts a police shooting

2. she faces music industry misogyny

3. she criss-crosses a nation ravaged by the #ClimateCrisis

Q2: In 2022, my goal is to finish an intersectional memoir about body/food/health/race/gender/US domestic+foreign policy/the environment+connecting it all to the #climatecrisis. I have several novels coming out, but non-fiction is newer for me. I have to warn my family! #LasMusas https://t.co/j2pvQOi8Gq

If you really believe that #BlackLivesMatter+want to put those principles into practice, then come join the #ClimateJustice movement. The #climatecrisis threatens us all, but is killing+endangering Black lives in the Americas+especially in Africa RIGHT NOW https://t.co/vUedM2eODl https://t.co/YMzPj25j9Q
